scripts.build:wasm: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const cp = require('child_process'); const path = require('path'); const out = 'src/wasm/pkg/image_suite_wasm.wasm'; try { const bin = path.join(process.env.USERPROFILE || process.env.HOME || '', '.cargo', 'bin'); process.env.PATH = bin + path.delimiter + process.env.PATH; cp.execSync('rustc --crate-type cdylib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -C opt-level=3 -C lto=yes -C panic=abort src/wasm/src/lib.rs -o ' + out, { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Compiled Rust WASM successfully'); } catch (e) { if (fs.existsSync(out)) { console.log('Using prebuilt WASM binary'); } else { throw e; } }"
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && tsc && vite build
